title: Rogue Clone
description: A terminal-based clone of the original 1980 procedural dungeon crawler, built using Python and the tcod library to learn core software architecture and tile-based rendering.
scope: Game Logic, Procedural Generation, Software Engineering

title: Notes App
description: A voice-first clinical intake application built in Python that uses a local Ollama Mistral instance to instantly transcribe spoken patient data and automatically populate structured electronic medical forms.
scope: Audio Processing, Local LLM Integration, Software Engineering

title: Interrogation Room
description: A terminal-based text adventure game built in Python, leveraging a local Ollama Mistral LLM to simulate dynamic suspect behavior and an AI officer who assesses the interrogation strategy.
scope: Game Design, LLM Prompt Engineering, Python Backend

title: Personal Portfolio
description: A clean, responsive portfolio website built using React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS to showcase my design and development projects.
